Глицин.about: Inhibitory amino acid: improves sleep onset (3 g) in selected RCTs; There are no meta-analyses - the base is weak.
Глицин.caution: Glycine is an inhibitory neurotransmitter. There are NO meta-analyses or systematic reviews in the database. Selected RCTs have shown: improvement in sleep quality (3 g at bedtime), adjuvant in schizophrenia (as an adjuvant to antipsychotics), maintenance of collagen synthesis. But there is no systematic assessment of these effects. Popular in biohacking circles, but the evidence base is weak.
Глицин.food_sources: Collagen/gelatin, meat, legumes - rich in glycine; It’s difficult to get a dose of 3 g from food.
Глицин.guidelines: SR 2024: nervous system - most positive effects, but data quality is low; doses 3 g before bedtime, courses up to 4 months.
Глицин.how_to_choose: If you try it, regular glycine 3 g before bedtime; the effect is subjective, you should not expect science (card D).

Глицин.myths: Proven sleep aid - SR 2024: improving sleep in small samples with high risk of bias. “Prolongs life”—an effect in animals, not in humans.
